name: Welcome To Sundersvelle
source:
Welcome to Sundersevelle!

Come get comfortable for a little while in a small town out somewhere in the middle of nowhere. Meet the characters and have a little fun reading.

[From [url=https://jollycoart.itch.io/welcome-to-sundersvelle]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
欢迎来到桑德塞维尔！

来一个偏僻的小镇享受一段舒适的时光吧。与角色见面并享受阅读的乐趣。

[来自[url=https://jollycoart.itch.io/welcome-to-sundersvelle]itch.io[/url]]
